title: SourceInterpretationValue
description: Value posted onto the SourceInterpretation panel. Polymorphic by `kind`. Open-ended; Sourcing Packs add new kinds. No SubjectIdentity is referenced here (interpretations precede identification).

kind.description: Open-ended discriminator. Examples: CodeUnit, OpenApiOperation, KafkaTopic, JpaEntity, MavenDependency, TestSpec, IacResource, GitCommit, FileTreeNode, ConfigEntry, ProtoMessage, GraphqlSchema, DbTable, ModuleSpec.

sourceIdentityKey.description: Stable per-source identity. MUST be deterministic for a given input.

contentRef.description: Reference into BundleStore for raw content.

payload.description: Kind-specific structured fields owned by the emitting Sourcing Pack.

signals.description: Free-form discriminator hints used by IdentificationKSs.
